notebooks.title: Compositional Heredity and Error Thresholds in Prebiotic Systems
notebooks.summary: Heritability and evolution can potentially precede the emergence of genetically encoded templates in non-equilibrium systems, driven by autocatalytic motifs. Informational stability is contingent upon copying fidelity maintaining composition across growth-division regimes.

notebooks.next_questions: How do physical growth constraints limit the achievable copying fidelity in early catalytic networks?
